verdict.rationale: Paxos documents an API-based onramp. Mint orchestrations convert USD to stablecoins when a bank transfer arrives, the Fiat Transfers API creates deposit instructions over Wire and CUBIX, and the Identity API onboards end-user persons. That covers bank-transfer purchases embedded via API, but nothing in the evidence shows card payments or an embeddable widget. missing for 10: card-payment funding, an embeddable onramp widget/UI, ACH or consumer bank-rail evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of an end-user buy flow

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed a fiat-to-stablecoin onramp — a documented widget or API where end users buy stablecoins with cards or bank transfers inside my product

citations.quote: Convert USD to Stablecoins and transfer all in one call.
This powerful feature enables seamless fiat-to-crypto conversions through rule-based orchestrations that trigger upon receiving bank transfers.
The Fiat Transfers API allows clients to deposit and withdraw fiat via Wire (Fedwire and SWIFT) and CUBIX networks.
Create a person identity and handle the onboarding decision on the Paxos Platform.
